question: Can the frozen suite compare context-policy configurations while keeping execution and quality evidence distinct?
design: Same frozen fixtures/rubric/model/task, file_references baseline vs recency candidate. Live n=1 each; non-contemporaneous runs. Deterministic execution tasks n=5 each, includes pressure/compaction. No superiority hypothesis.
controlled_difference: Context selection policy only; carried agent prompt and notes behavior unchanged; headless helper restores identical permission semantics.
limitations: Live task fits both budgets, so selection policies retain all items. Live timing/token differences cannot be attributed to policy; no routing/model-quality ranking.
Old live baseline ran in combined desktop checkout; runtime task path is headless. New candidate uses main-based checkout; no clean revision comparison claim.
Scripted success scores execution contracts only.
Cost, true TTFT and decode throughput unavailable.
conclusion: Comparison mechanism demonstrated with observed metrics and separately graded live outputs. Both configurations pass this limited sample; evidence does not prefer either policy.

pressure_selection_evidence.observation: Same fixed history/budget: recency retains noise.rs, file_references retains target.rs; both retain latest.rs and admit exact request. Deterministic selection behavior, no model quality score.
